project.title: The interacting protein peptide sequences of stathmin
project.projectDescription: The peptide sequences identified by mass spectrometry in the proteins immunoprecipitated from stathmin-GFP expressed HEK293T lysates with the GFP-beads.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: To identify proteins interacting with stathmin-GFP, the immunoprecipitated proteins bound to GFP-beads were subjected to mass spectrometry by Lu-Ming Biotech Co. (Shanghai, China).
project.dataProcessingProtocol: The data processing was conducted using the Q-Exactive mass spectrometer.
